notes.title: Angry Cat - Game Launch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42731443/d89ab3d0bd7ad7a1c171d797c87913e025aba0b1.gif[/img]

Hello cat lovers
I have great news, the game will be released on [b]August 26th[/b].

[previewyoutube=nugQzULiLd8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Angry Cat[/b] will immerse you in a fun and rewarding adventure. In the game you will have to control two kittens, one with the mouse and the other with the keyboard. Show all your skill and coordination in this action-packed game. Can you lead the kittens to victory?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426540/Angry_Cat/


Add the game to your wishlist and share it with your friends, family, strangers, random people, me, and the stray cats.

😻
